text: My brother fixed the fence on Saturday.
ir: (assert (e1 fix :tense past :subj (m1 brother :poss (m2 I :pron)) :obj (m3 fence :det the) :obl-on (m4 Saturday :propn)))

text: Lena usually walks to work.
ir: (assert (e1 walk :tense pres :subj (m1 Lena :propn) :obl-to (m2 work) :adv usually))

text: The store will close early tomorrow.
ir: (assert (e1 close :tense fut :subj (m1 store :det the) :adv early :adv tomorrow))

text: We were watching a movie when the lights failed.
ir: (assert (e1 watch :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 movie :det a) :when (e2 fail :tense past :subj (m3 light :det the :num pl))))

text: I'm cooking pasta for the kids.
ir: (assert (e1 cook :tense pres :aspect prog :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 pasta) :obl-for (m3 kid :det the :num pl)))

text: They'll be traveling through Spain in June.
ir: (assert (e1 travel :tense fut :aspect prog :subj (m1 they :pron :ref none) :obl-through (m2 Spain :propn) :obl-in (m3 June :propn)))

text: She had already eaten when I called.
ir: (assert (e1 eat :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m1 she :pron :ref none) :adv already :when (e2 call :tense past :subj (m2 I :pron))))

text: I've lost my wallet again.
ir: (assert (e1 lose :tense pres :aspect perf :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 wallet :poss (m3 I :pron)) :adv again))

text: By noon, the painters will have finished the kitchen.
ir: (assert (e1 finish :tense fut :aspect perf :subj (m1 painter :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 kitchen :det the) :obl-by (m3 noon)))

text: Tom had been waiting for an hour before the bus came.
ir: (assert (e1 wait :tense past :aspect perfprog :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :obl-for (m2 hour :det a) :before (e2 come :tense past :subj (m3 bus :det the))))

text: They've been saving money for a new car.
ir: (assert (e1 save :tense pres :aspect perfprog :subj (m1 they :pron :ref none) :obj (m2 money) :obl-for (m3 car :det a :adj new)))
notes: Present perfect progressive; contraction they've. "for a new car" attached to the verb (purpose-like PP); noun attachment to "money" is implausible.

text: In May, Nadia will have been teaching for ten years.
ir: (assert (e1 teach :tense fut :aspect perfprog :subj (m1 Nadia :propn) :obl-in (m2 May :propn) :obl-for (m3 year :det ten :num pl)))

text: The kids didn't finish their vegetables.
ir: (assert (e1 finish :tense past :pol neg :subj (m1 kid :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 vegetable :num pl :poss (m3 they :pron :ref m1))))
notes: Past simple negative. Possessive "their" exempt from binding; only plural candidate is m1.

text: My phone doesn't charge properly anymore.
ir: (assert (e1 charge :tense pres :pol neg :subj (m1 phone :poss (m2 I :pron)) :adv properly :adv anymore))

text: I won't need the car tomorrow.
ir: (assert (e1 need :tense fut :pol neg :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 car :det the) :adv tomorrow))

text: You weren't listening to me.
ir: (assert (e1 listen :tense past :aspect prog :pol neg :subj (m1 you :pron) :obl-to (m2 I :pron)))

text: The office printer isn't working again.
ir: (assert (e1 work :tense pres :aspect prog :pol neg :subj (m1 printer :det the :compound office) :adv again))
notes: Present progressive negative; contraction isn't; compound.

text: We won't be staying at that hotel again.
ir: (assert (e1 stay :tense fut :aspect prog :pol neg :subj (m1 we :pron) :obl-at (m2 hotel :det that) :adv again))

text: Rosa hadn't seen the ocean before that trip.
ir: (assert (e1 see :tense past :aspect perf :pol neg :subj (m1 Rosa :propn) :obj (m2 ocean :det the) :obl-before (m3 trip :det that)))
notes: Past perfect negative; contraction hadn't. "before" + NP is a PP (:obl-before), not a clause relation.

text: They haven't replied to my message yet.
ir: (assert (e1 reply :tense pres :aspect perf :pol neg :subj (m1 they :pron :ref none) :obl-to (m2 message :poss (m3 I :pron)) :adv yet))

text: The paint won't have dried by the morning.
ir: (assert (e1 dry :tense fut :aspect perf :pol neg :subj (m1 paint :det the) :obl-by (m2 morning :det the)))

text: She hadn't been sleeping well for weeks.
ir: (assert (e1 sleep :tense past :aspect perfprog :pol neg :subj (m1 she :pron :ref none) :obl-for (m2 week :num pl) :adv well))

text: I haven't been sleeping much lately.
ir: (assert (e1 sleep :tense pres :aspect perfprog :pol neg :subj (m1 I :pron) :adv much :adv lately))

text: By June, he won't have been working here for a year.
ir: (assert (e1 work :tense fut :aspect perfprog :pol neg :subj (m1 he :pron :ref none) :obl-by (m2 June :propn) :obl-for (m3 year :det a) :adv here))

text: My grandfather never drinks coffee after lunch.
ir: (assert (e1 drink :tense pres :pol neg :negword never :subj (m1 grandfather :poss (m2 I :pron)) :obj (m3 coffee) :obl-after (m4 lunch)))

text: I have never been to Japan.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :aspect perf :pol neg :negword never :subj (m1 I :pron) :obl-to (m2 Japan :propn)))

text: Ben never called me back.
ir: (assert (e1 call :tense past :pol neg :negword never :subj (m1 Ben :propn) :obj (m2 I :pron) :adv back))

text: You can park behind the building.
ir: (assert (e1 park :mod can :subj (m1 you :pron) :obl-behind (m2 building :det the)))

text: Maya could have missed the train.
ir: (assert (e1 miss :mod could :aspect perf :subj (m1 Maya :propn) :obj (m2 train :det the)))

text: Guests may use the pool until midnight.
ir: (assert (e1 use :mod may :subj (m1 guest :num pl) :obj (m2 pool :det the) :obl-until (m3 midnight)))
notes: "until" + NP is a PP (:obl-until), not the :until clause relation.

text: It might snow tomorrow.
ir: (assert (e1 snow :mod might :subj (m1 it :pron :ref none) :adv tomorrow))

text: You must wear a helmet on the construction site.
ir: (assert (e1 wear :mod must :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 helmet :det a) :obl-on (m3 site :det the :compound construction)))

text: We should leave soon or we'll miss the bus.
ir: (assert (or (e1 leave :mod should :subj (m1 we :pron) :adv soon) (e2 miss :tense fut :subj (m2 we :pron) :obj (m3 bus :det the))))

text: I would never lie to you.
ir: (assert (e1 lie :pol neg :negword never :mod would :subj (m1 I :pron) :obl-to (m2 you :pron)))

text: You can't smoke in the hospital.
ir: (assert (e1 smoke :pol neg :mod can :subj (m1 you :pron) :obl-in (m2 hospital :det the)))

text: She shouldn't drive in this weather.
ir: (assert (e1 drive :pol neg :mod should :subj (m1 she :pron :ref none) :obl-in (m2 weather :det this)))

text: The museum must have closed early.
ir: (assert (e1 close :mod must :aspect perf :subj (m1 museum :det the) :adv early))

text: You might not like the ending.
ir: (assert (e1 like :pol neg :mod might :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 ending :det the)))

text: The windows were cleaned yesterday.
ir: (assert (e1 clean :tense past :voice pass :subj (m1 window :det the :num pl) :adv yesterday))

text: The old bridge is being repaired.
ir: (assert (e1 repair :tense pres :aspect prog :voice pass :subj (m1 bridge :det the :adj old)))

text: The letter had been opened before it arrived.
ir: (assert (e1 open :tense past :aspect perf :voice pass :subj (m1 letter :det the) :before (e2 arrive :tense past :subj (m2 it :pron :ref m1))))
notes: Past perfect passive. "it" has a single candidate (the letter).

text: The results will be announced on Friday.
ir: (assert (e1 announce :tense fut :voice pass :subj (m1 result :det the :num pl) :obl-on (m2 Friday :propn)))

text: My car has been stolen twice.
ir: (assert (e1 steal :tense pres :aspect perf :voice pass :subj (m1 car :poss (m2 I :pron)) :adv twice))

text: The cake wasn't eaten by the guests.
ir: (assert (e1 eat :tense past :pol neg :voice pass :subj (m1 cake :det the) :obl-by (m2 guest :det the :num pl)))

text: These shirts are made in Portugal.
ir: (assert (e1 make :tense pres :voice pass :subj (m1 shirt :det these :num pl) :obl-in (m2 Portugal :propn)))

text: We're going to visit my aunt soon.
ir: (assert (e1 visit :tense fut :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 aunt :poss (m3 I :pron)) :adv soon))

text: It isn't going to rain today.
ir: (assert (e1 rain :tense fut :pol neg :subj (m1 it :pron :ref none) :adv today))

text: No one came to the meeting.
ir: (assert (e1 come :tense past :subj (m1 one :det no) :obl-to (m2 meeting :det the)))
notes: "No one" = head "one" with :det no; clause polarity positive.

text: Nobody answered the phone.
ir: (assert (e1 answer :tense past :subj (m1 nobody) :obj (m2 phone :det the)))
notes: Spec only covers two-word "no one". Single-word "nobody" kept as head "nobody" (cannot split into det+head without inventing anchors); clause polarity positive.

text: Nothing has changed since Monday.
ir: (assert (e1 change :tense pres :aspect perf :subj (m1 nothing) :obl-since (m2 Monday :propn)))
notes: As with "nobody": head "nothing", positive polarity. Spec silent on single-word negative quantifiers.
